both_correct_rate.numerator: reference and variant both correct (score > 0 means class 1)

accuracy.numerator: examples whose prediction equals the label (recomputed from each classification row)

summary: Independent protocol assessor: paired difference under the frozen plan's charter rule, with a conservative two-way (training seed x held-out example) interval and a Student t critical value; one seed reduces to the plain paired t-interval over examples. Metrics: paired-report/1 both-correct-rate and reference-accuracy (reference/variant pair rows), and classification-report/1:accuracy (ordinary multiclass accuracy from eidos.task.paired-classification-report rows; strict example-id match across arms).
